tools.name: capacity_check
tools.description: Estimates an agency's accounts per account manager, yearly coordination cost, and how many more accounts the same team could carry at a target ratio. Use when the user shares client and team numbers and asks about capacity, hiring, or account manager load. Returns an estimate, not a guarantee.

tools.name: rebrief_tax
tools.description: Estimates the monthly hours and cost a team spends explaining clients to AI tools before they do useful work. Use when the user asks what re-briefing AI or re-pasting client context costs.

tools.name: capacity_benchmarks
tools.description: Returns published benchmarks on accounts per account manager, time spent re-briefing AI, and rework of AI output, each with its source link. Use when the user asks what is normal for agencies.

tools.name: client_context_template
tools.description: Returns a fill-in template for a 1-file client context document (goals, voice, claims rules, priorities, approvals, decisions) for a service line. Use when the user wants AI tools or new teammates to stop needing a client re-brief.

tools.name: approval_checklist
tools.description: Returns an 8-check review list for AI-drafted client work, plus checks for the service line and how much review each risk level needs. Use when the user asks how to QA AI output before it reaches a client.

tools.name: define_term
tools.description: Defines an agency AI operations term, such as Portable Delivery Intelligence, accounts per person, re-brief tax, or AI operations sprawl. Leave term empty to list all terms.

tools.name: add_to_benchmark
tools.description: Adds 1 anonymous response to the Agency Capacity Benchmark run by Agile Growth Labs. Only call when the user explicitly agrees to share their numbers. Stores no name, email, or company. Max 3 per day per network.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "capacity" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: approval_checklist · Private data: client_context_template · Public sink: add_to_benchmark · Destructive: add_to_benchmark.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: approval_checklist · Private data: client_context_template · Public sink: add_to_benchmark · Destructive: add_to_benchmark

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
